methodologyNotes: Pricing re-verified via WebFetch on each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-18: waitwhile.com/pricing, qminder.com/pricing, skiplino.com/pricing, tablesready.com/pricing, qless.com/products, waitly.com/pricing. NextMe's nextmeapp.com/pricing returned HTTP 403, so NextMe pricing was confirmed via the vendor's own help-center billing article (Business $99.99/mo or $959.88/yr) and corroborated by web search; the third-party Capterra listing's $79.99/mo Business figure is stale and was NOT used. Compliance verified on vendor pages: Waitwhile SOC2 Type II + HIPAA(BAA) + GDPR via blog and help articles; Qminder SOC2 Type II + HIPAA(BAA) + GDPR + TX-RAMP via /security. Skiplino, TablesReady, QLess, Waitly publish no compliance certifications, so those fields are null. TablesReady Starter/Business prices are billed-annually monthly-equivalent rates (the only self-serve pricing published). Enterprise/quote-only tiers have monthlyUsd=null. All accessedAt=2026-06-18.
